name: @veren/mail-bundle
description: Use when a DSH host needs notification capability installed and composed in one step: this configuration-only bundle mounts the notification domain core (durable workflows, recipients, groups, preferences, execution chains in the host storage domain, trigger -> dispatch -> deliver with atomic claiming and at-most-three retries, the station inbox over the in_app channel, and the `mail` Remote namespace), the model-facing mail_* tools with the bundled mail-notifications skill, and the web panel (inbox with seen/read/archived actions and the per-step activity view) as one installable profile layer.
_comment_dependencies: Member packages use workspace ranges; a release publishes the whole line at one version.
